description: Overwrite a cell range (A1 notation) in a spreadsheet with a 2D grid of values. Runs as a background job: dispatch returns a job_id immediately, and the count of cells updated arrives via a follow-up message once it completes. Requires a connected account.
embedding_description: Write a 2D grid into an existing Google Sheets spreadsheet as a background job, starting at the top-left cell of an A1 range and interpreting formulas, dates, and formatted numbers as user-entered values. Dispatch returns a job_id for tracking; completion delivers the count of cells written.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Job queued for the spreadsheet update; completion will be delivered automatically.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Return exactly one action using the active IO plugin's post_message (process_key: plugin::<io_plugin>::post_message). Use the provided session_id. Keep the message short and friendly. Do NOT invent process identifiers (no present_result, no status actions).

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Dispatch a background job to overwrite a cell range in a Google Sheets spreadsheet.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.invalid_params: missing id/range, values is empty or not a list of row lists, or missing session_id/flow_id context. gsuite.not_found: the spreadsheet id does not exist. gsuite.not_connected: no account linked. gsuite.api_error: AsyncJobManager unavailable or job creation failed.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: gsuite.invalid_params: supply a non-empty 2D values grid matching the range. gsuite.not_connected: run connect_account. gsuite.api_error: retry once platform startup has completed.
